messages:
Alex: morning async — quick status from gateway (routing / auth / rate limits)
Alex: what I did: shipped routing-policy-v3 canary to eu-west at 2% traffic; verified JWT rotation path; opened PR #4823 for auth header fallback
Alex: short repro on staging for header fallback + notes in the PR
Priya: nice. any regressions on tail latencies or error rates?
Alex: tail: p50 12ms p95 88ms p99 210ms in synthetic; saw a few 503 spikes correlated with bursts
Sam: can you paste the log snippet where the 503s show up?
Alex: log snippet:
```
2026-03-16T10:15:23Z gw[auth] WARN rate_limit exceeded key=user:123 burst=160 capacity=0
2026-03-16T10:15:23Z gw[router] ERROR upstream failure: 503 from backend-a
```
Alex: quick hypothesis: token-bucket burst config + new batching means tokens get used up faster on short spikes
Morgan: metrics note — after the batching change we saw ~12% more request coalescing; rate limiter tokens trend down quicker during small bursts
Taylor: reminder: infra maintenance today 16:00-17:00 PST, avoid big rollouts in that window
Jamie: i'll take the PR review and add a unit test for the fallback path later today
Priya: as a mitigation, what if we lower burst to 50 briefly? smooths the limiter but might throttle some clients sooner
Alex: agreed as a short-term experiment. applying to staging now, will watch 5min windows
infra-bot: canary rollout (routing-policy-v3) -> 2% traffic -> success
Sam: i'll look through the logs and PR after lunch. ping me once staging has the lowered burst applied
Alex: blocker: need confirmation that lowering burst won't break the internal batcher. @Morgan can you sanity-check with local sim?
Morgan: quick sim: lowering to 50 increases avg per-request latency by ~+5ms but removes the 503 spike in the scenario. looks safe to try on staging
Priya: ok go ahead. if error rate drops we'll push to canary 10% then monitor
Alex: next steps today: apply burst change to staging, monitor 5/15/60m windows, if stable move to canary 10% and tag oncall
Sam: also adding a small instrumentation point to log remaining bucket tokens per request — will send a PR to the metrics repo
Jamie: dropped a comment on #4823 about adding an integration test for JWT rotation + rate-limiter interplay
Alex: thanks — no other blockers from my side. i'll post updates after the 10% canary
Priya: :thumbsup:
Sam: :eyes:
Morgan: :white_check_mark:
Taylor: glhf
